messages:
anna: Hey team — PR ready for runtime batching + KV eviction change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/17654
Summary: decouple eviction header handling from batch runner; add opt-in `eviction_policy: "strict"` flag; emit an autoscaler hint header for long-running sequences. Need approvals from platform/infra/security before merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT. Tagging owners: @kevin (platform), @sylvia (infra), @dave (sec), @oliver (runtime). CI passing locally, canary plan below. Can someone take quick eyes? cc @maria for rollout ops.

oliver: looking now — main question: does `eviction_policy: strict` change default behavior? can this cause latency spikes? :thinking_face:

anna: good q. default remains `eviction_policy: lax` — strict must be enabled per-deployment. Added note in config docs. Latency impact small — we add background compaction but avoid blocking token generation. I'll paste diff snippet.

anna: ```diff
@@ -42,6 +42,9 @@ class KVCache:
-    def maybe_evict(self):
-        # old behavior
+    def maybe_evict(self):
+        # new: honor eviction_policy flag
+        if self.config.eviction_policy == "strict":
+            self.background_compact()
         ...
```

kevin: I'll review autoscaler hint parts. Do we need a platform migration step? If the hint key name changes we'll need to update the autoscaler mapping.

anna: no key rename, just extra field `eviction_hint=compact_soon` emitted on long sequences. Platform should ignore if unknown. Example header: `X-Redwood-Eviction: compact_soon`.

sylvia: infra note — need unit tests for header parsing and an e2e vacuum test for memory leak. Also please run stress test with 2x seq len or we block.

dave: security — surface looks limited. Two asks: (1) confirm header isn't user-controllable in hosted mode (no injection), (2) update threat model doc if it becomes client-visible. Otherwise ok.

runtime-ci-bot: build/17654 status: ✅ tests passed (1294), integration: flaky 1/20, canary image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:pr-17654-rc1

maria: ops — canary schedule ok for 03:00 PT tonight. If infra needs more testing we can delay to 08:00. please confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

anna: thanks all — I'll follow up with unit tests and run the 2x stress overnight. If no objections we aim to merge in the 10:00 PT window tomorrow.
